status_semantics.planned: Capability is in the approved target scope; implementation is not asserted.
status_semantics.implemented: Code exists and has been reviewed; tests are still required.
status_semantics.tested: Automated tests and CI evidence are attached.
status_semantics.operational: Live runtime evidence and monitoring prove the capability works.
